_comment: RV-5 model A/B batch plan — declared and frozen BEFORE any A/B run (hashed in freeze_manifest.json). Both models run exactly the same batches, scenarios, hidden truth, evaluator v3, rubric, skill code, prompts, Human scripts, Harness budget / release reserve and wall-clock timeouts; only the provider block differs (IDR-RV5-07). Every run listed is executed and reported; nothing is added, dropped or rerun based on outcomes. A patch to any frozen file invalidates the A/B (new version, both models restart from scratch).

B.desc: fresh continuous golden scenarios A-D, 3 repetitions each

provider_notes: Claude via `claude -p` (ClaudeCLIProvider, effort medium, native --json-schema, no tools / MCP / settings, timeout 420 s). The CLI exposes no temperature or max-token setting: the temperature-equivalent is the CLI default and the output size is bounded by the same JSON schemas (maxLength / maxItems) for both arms — recorded as a fairness caveat. User-selected (no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY / OPENAI_API_KEY in this environment).
